posts.author: ColinBenson
posts.body:
I'm trying to create a collapsing bridge in my game. I play tested it with two tiles.
(Stepping on a cracked section sets off a separate trigger and after a half second, the bridge collapses and if the player's still standing on the tile, they're send to the lower level.)
It worked just fine with two, so I added several of the same tiles with separate triggers and I've noticed that if I have that many triggers/timers going on at the same time, RPG Maker gets confused and the timers, tiles and falls to the lower floor get garbled. (Tiles break without the timer/player falls to lower floor despite standing on a solid tile.)
Is there some way I can program my game to have several collapsing bridge tiles going on without such problems?
Edit: Never mind, I got it working.
